Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
Enumeration of dataset types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion can be made about the completeness of the relationship.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Element is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The planned location that a good, product or material is stored.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.
Categories of presence or absence.
The name of a relevant standard that may apply to an artifact.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset can be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need to know basis.
Specifies the level of support associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `from` action is performedBy `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.
The provider of a SoftwareService.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
A text describing the actual need defined by the requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.
The percentile of the current probability score.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).
A code that identifies a county.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.
Unit in which energy is measured.
Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability's details were tracked, aggregated, and/or enriched to improve context (i.e. NVD) by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Artifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Enumeration of verification types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.
A key with an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.
The Agent who is responsible for product branding such as an OEM.
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.
This class represents the process involved in manufacturing products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.
Defines the end of a range.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.
Describes if any sensitive personal information is present in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` ResolutionAction point to the `to` OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
Unit of energy consumption.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/LicenseAddition is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/ExtendableLicense is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).
This is a set of point coordinates as defined in by the GPS standard.
Expression for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.
ISO level of automation.
A evidenceUUID is a universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to an entity, item, or requirement.
Energy quantity.
Availability of dataset.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.
Availability of a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.
Safety risk level.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.
A string in the license expression format.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record the package URL string (in accordance with the Package URL specification) for a software Package.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).
Provides information about the creation of the Element.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record acknowledgement text for a software Package, File or Snippet.
The destruction process is defined in this process.

Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Extension/Extension is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Defines the level of automation a system possesses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.
QUDT unit is used for measurement criteria based on product type, region and use.
Specifies the type of an annotation.
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.
Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.

The location for dropping off or delivering a package or item.

Identifier for specific product is called a serial number.
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.
Confidentiality level.
